content:
“Sure, you're still human - on the outside!”

**Ghoulish** is a perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Gain health regeneration while receiving rads.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Radiation now regenerates even more of your lost Health! | 00065E23 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Radiation now regenerates more of your lost Health. | 00065E22 | 
| ★ | 1 | Radiation now regenerates your lost Health. | 0004D89E | 

- Ghoulish 1 / 2 / 3 restores 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 HP for every 1 radiation damage acquired, this only works while actively being irradiated.
- What Rads? radiation regeneration does not negatively impact the Ghoulish perk healing.
- Radiation Resistance through power armor, Rad-X, etc will decrease the effectiveness of Ghoulish.
- Ghoulish does not eliminate radiation damage. As radiation accumulates, available HP capacity will continue to decrease.
